title: Argo Workflows Failures by Workflow
app: Argo Workflows controller logs and the Argo API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=argo:workflow phase="Failed" OR phase="Error"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by workflow_template
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Argo Workflows failures grouped by workflow so operators immediately see which specific workflows are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Argo Workflows is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Argo Workflows failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical workflows.
visualization: Table of workflow by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Argo Workflows are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
